findings.problem: The packet does not bind immutable evidence that Issues #75-#78 were accepted, merged, synchronized and closed before declaring the #79 frontier.
findings.required_change: Bind the exact prior acceptance identities, PR #83 merge, Issue closures, synchronized integration commit and the later governance checkpoint used as #79 source base.

findings.problem: Ticket-review fields use a ticket revision as if it were an approved manual guide.
findings.required_change: Use explicit pre-guide ticket-review sentinel semantics that cannot satisfy the later guide-review or guide-lock gate.

findings.problem: No case proves exact guide approval/digest lock, append-only Evaluation history, prior-run immutability and explicit human approval of the exact PASSED run.
findings.required_change: Add a dedicated guide-and-Evaluation lifecycle case with before/after history and approval oracles.

findings.problem: The packet requests exact matrices but does not enumerate all public variants with status, recursive body keys, state effects and provider counters.
findings.required_change: Require independently sourced literal matrices for lookup, proposal, decision, execution and reconciliation results/errors.

findings.problem: The closed provider failures target_not_found, validation_rejected and policy_rejected are not separate durable/public rows.
findings.required_change: Enumerate success and each closed rejection with restart-stable SQLite outcome, Knora finalization and no-effect rejection proof.

findings.problem: The contract does not distinguish tested subject SHA from later evidence/Evaluation commits, creating a self-reference or invalidation ambiguity.
findings.required_change: Define tested_subject_sha, evidence publication order, evidence-only descendants and selective-invalidation proof.

findings.problem: Three skipped tests are not inventoried and a green exit alone does not prove complete M1-M3 regression coverage.
findings.required_change: Bind collected/pass/fail/skip/xfail node identities, classify every skip and prohibit new or weakened skip/xfail coverage.

findings.problem: The revision uses DATABASE_URL while the repository runtime uses KNORA_DATABASE_URL.
findings.required_change: Use KNORA_DATABASE_URL consistently and bind effective sanitized host/database, CWD, interpreter and exit for every PostgreSQL/Alembic command.

findings.problem: Preparing an actual fixed-point descriptor before #79 integration/closure could pin a stale head.
findings.required_change: Limit #79 to a non-binding readiness checklist/template and forbid creating or validating the actual descriptor until the leader integrates and closes #79.

findings.problem: The supplied design digest is not reproducible from the current authoritative design file and no exact blob/projection is identified.
findings.required_change: Bind the exact Git design blob and state the digest algorithm or update the digest to a reproducible raw SHA-256.
